svg.title: Variable-size GNN coupling designer with supervised sparsity selector
svg.desc: A compact architecture diagram showing input preprocessing, a budget-conditioned Gaussian GNN policy, exact-budget connected pruning and VCSEL simulation, phase-only REINFORCE learning, supervised maximum-error sparsity selection, and one-candidate inference.

g.text: used by the selector, not by the phase policy
Conditional GNN Gaussian policy πψ(a | x, ρ)
xᵢ = [cos θᵢ*, sin θᵢ*, δ̃ᵢ, ρᵦ]
same learned functions for every node and edge
Connectivity is guaranteed by a maximum-weight spanning tree plus the strongest remaining links.
no sparsity term in the policy reward
q* = first tested budget with eₘₐₓ,ᵦ ≤ εₘₐₓ
q̂ = σ(a − c₁u − c₂u² − c₃u³), cₖ > 0
q̂ is not simulated during training
policy mean μψ(x, ρ*) → connected pruning
one deterministic design; no budget scan
conditioned on phase target, detuning, M,

g.textext:text: Conditional GNN Gaussian Policy $\\pi_\\psi(\\mathbf a\\mid\\mathbf x,\\rho)$
